balls.text: shorter side of a length, heading into middle and leg. Swatted to extra cover

the leg stump is uprooted! That was launched at 150kph, though Maxwell's bat swing seemed quicker still. Good length ball on middle and off, and angles in. Maxwell is too early into his heave across the line, and is completely blown by the pace and movement. But what an innings!

Wood gets one slightly wrong, and Maxwell's eyes lit up! Again Maxwell is across off a bit, as Wood fires a shortish ball angling into middle and off. Maxwell pulled, and sent that flaying over deep backward square
gets across early, and Wood fires a yorker length ball outside leg. Maxwell flicks but misses, and called wide

again makes room, and now Wood bangs it in short on off. That angles in again with good bounce, as Maxwell misses on his pull. First bouncer called. And FWIW, Rahul has reviewed for a potential caught behind. Replays show the ball actually headed below Maxwell's bat while he was trying to pull and missed. Far from the bat eventually, and that review was nothing but a slowdown
swats off the splice of the bat to point, as this good length ball shapes into leg, with Maxwell making room. Too much pace for him to handle
very good ball. Executes a yorker bang on middle stump, as du Plessis squeezes it out to long-on off the bottom of the bat
low full toss on middle - a low yorker - as du Plessis swipes to long leg
yorker length again on the stumps - why doesn't he bowl this more often? - as du Plessis jams to deep midwicket to pinch two
flashed wide of long-off! A flat-batted swish, and four. He goes low to meet this very full ball just outside off, and even as the bat turns in his hand, he gets what he wanted
yorker on off at 134kph, and drilled to long-on

how was that six!? I am scratching my head over this one. Anyway, it's fifty for Maxwell off 24 balls. Shorter side of a length outside off, as he punched-swatted-cut - whatever you say - over deep point

six bang down the ground! I never it got that right with the angle even with a compass in school. Length delivery shaping in, and ending just outside off. Maxwell, deep in the crease, fires it over the bowler's head
four to deep third! Unadkat leaks 23. Another low full toss angling across and ending wide-ish of off, as du Plessis slices it over short third while playing it late. The boundaries keep coming
full, dipping, and lands wide of off. Du Plessis tries to reach out and misses. Wide ball

this lands over fine leg! It was a high-ish full toss on middle, as du Plessis pulled. And expectedly, he has called for a review as he looks for an above-waist full toss so he gets a no-ball, and a free hit. Replays show that was heading downwards, as du Plessis met it below his waist. Six still
that one lands in the second tier! Over long-on, and six more. Length ball on the stumps from Unadkat, as du Plessis stands with his front leg out of the way to slam that for six

dropped by Krunal at deep third! He overran to his right, the ball popped out his hands, and landed close to the rope to his left. Maxwell again sliced that hard and high, with the ball being very full and wide of off

off the toe-end of the bat, and four! Fired in very full and quite wide of off, as Maxwell opened the bat face and reached out, only to mistime it. But deep third was quite wide, and it raced away to his left
starts with a full toss on leg, which du Plessis swings to deep midwicket
ah, looks to scoop but is beaten. Gets across off, as the ball is on a good length and around sixth stump. The ball passes his inside edge
sliced away expertly! Low full toss angling into middle - and is a low full toss - as he makes room and goes inside out over extra cover. Maxwell on the charge
hoicks this full ball from outside off to deep midwicket off the inside half of his bat
almost a collision between long-on running to his right, and deep midwicket to his left. Full toss on middle, and lofted down by Maxwell. Too full for his liking
brilliant ball. An attempted yorker on middle, which becomes a low full toss, as Maxwell swings wide of long-on. Du Plessis pushes for two
flung away over deep square leg! Hello, Avesh. Length ball - right in the slot - on middle and off, as Maxwell is sitting deep in the crease, and finally timed his across-the-line hoick
and a Maxwell-like miss for du Plessis. Good length on middle, darting to end outside leg, as du Plessis looks to swing but misses
hoicked to deep midwicket on the bounce. No real timing, as this quite full angled into middle, and took the inside half of his bat
quite full - not really a yorker though - angling in to end on fifth stump. Drilled to mid-off
just past leg stump! Maxwell continues to struggle against Wood, as the latter gets it to skid off a good length, while angling it in. Maxwell tried to pull, and missed
now Wood goes for the yorker on the stumps, as du Plessis clips it to deep midwicket
wow, what a pleasing shot! That's his fifty too. Just lofts that with the full face of the bat, with the good length around off - and the pace on the ball - taking it away over long-off
short delivery, and called wide. Wood and Pooran aren't pleased. Short ball dug in, and angling in, as du Plessis shaped to pull and had to let it go

six number three this over! That is 20 taken from Bishnoi. He had given away 19 in his three overs until now. What a day to have! Full, tossed up and on the stumps, as Maxwell just hit through the line to bludgeon that down the ground
turns in off a good length, as the ball ends just outside off. Slammed to long-off
this is... out of the ground! Du Plessis making this crowd go bang-bang! Short ball just outside off, hinting to turn in. Du Plessis is deep in the ground to clobber that 115 meters away
swatted away stylishly! He overbalances a little, but that's fine. Short and a bit wide of off, as du Plessis made room early. Bishnoi saw that, but still got punished
heaves this quite full just outside off, and goes across the line to hit wide of long-on
good length on off, and pushed back
again lets go a yorker on the stumps, as du Plessis, after making room, can only jam it back to the bowler
yorker length on off, and tossed up too. Jammed to long-off
launched over long-on! Fuller ball on the stumps, as Maxwell made room and absolutely crashed that even if that didn't seem to have come off the middle of the bat
four to deep point! Makes room, and dispatches this short ball outside off - this was a legspinner from Mishra - as Maxwell for four
the ball pops up off Mishra's stuck-out right hand, although it wasn't very easy. Shortish ball on the stumps, as du Plessis banged that away
full and just outside off. Swiped to long-on, as the ball was too full for his liking
fires a yorker on middle at 151kph, and du Plessis can only squeeze it to mid-on
shorter side of a length just outside off. Punched to cover

Pooran dives to his left, but can't stop it. Du Plessis is across off, as Wood bowls on a length down leg. Takes his pad, and dribbles away for leg byes. There was a puff of dust after the ball pitched
much fuller ball shaping down, and takes his front pad as he tries to swing behind
shorter ball - and Wood has a fall again - pitches just outside off, and heads into off. Good bounce and pace, and Maxwell fends it down with his bottom hand off
hurries on to him off a good length, while angling into middle at 145kph. Pushed to mid-off
full and flat on off at 100kph. Driven to long-off
very full and straight, and pushed to long-on
the point fielder turns around and stretches his left hand out after running back, and the ball just falls beyond. Full and loopy - also wide of off - as Maxwell was lured into his slice

finds deep midwicket! Mishra strikes in his first over. Kohli looked to pull this short ball, but didn't really get the ideal bounce off the pitch. Looked it was the wrong 'un, as it angled down middle and leg. Mishra breaks through for LSG, as RCB are checked
makes room, as Mishra bowls much fuller and on the stumps. Driven to long-off
half-swatted to deep point on the bounce, as the ball is short around off
looks to hack but is beaten, as the ball keeps low off a good length on sixth stump
much fuller and flatter on off. Nudged to deep midwicket
turns in off a shortish length, and hits his front pad, which is outside leg, as he is beaten on the pull
shortish ball hinting to turn into middle from off stump. Pulled to fine leg
shortish and wide of off, and four to deep backward point! Du Plessis on the move after a slow start. The ball just straightened outside off, as du Plessis stood deep in the crease
good length on middle, and swiped to fine leg
length ball shaping into off. Punched to long-off
flatter and shorter, heading down leg. Cramps him for room, as he pulls to long-on
just beats deep midwicket to his left! Off the inside half of his bat, as he hoicked this full ball on middle and off across the line
full on middle, and clipped to short fine's left
pulled wide over long-on! A boundary after quite a while. Pandya went short, darting it into middle. Kohli rammed that for six while slamming with the angle
length ball on the stumps at 104kph. Punched to extra cover
again turns in off a good length to end close to off. Punched to deep point, and Kohli pushes for two
fired in short just outside off, and swung to long-on to raise his fifty. My ears are really being tested today by this crowd
turns in off a length to end on off. Pushed to cover to keep ticking
full and straight, and clipped to deep midwicket
much fuller, and hinting to turn into middle and off. Pushed to the bowler's left
shortish just outside off, and whipped to deep midwicket
shortish and on the stumps. Swatted to long-off
quite full on his pads, and flicked to short fine's left
good length ball darted in at 102kph, as it takes his front pad towards point while he misses his clip
much fuller ball and straighter too. Pushed wide of long-on
ah, comes in with the arm to end on middle and leg after pitching short around off. Slashed to deep point
very slow, and full on off. Tucked towards point
googly now. Turns in slightly off a good length from sixth stump, and is hacked to point's right
a bit of a mix-up, but they go for it in the end, as this full ball outside off is pushed towards cover
short and wide of off. Slapped to deep point
short ball, heading down leg while keeping low. Takes Kohli's pad to the keeper, as he misses his pull. Nope, it's called wide. So there was no pad for sure
very full and wide of off, as Kohli drills it back to the bowler with a flat bat
full and straight, and flicked to fine leg
quite full just outside off at 100kph. Driven to deep point
dabs this shortish ball rising nicely on top of the stumps to deep third, as he gets across early
another rapid single. Good length and shaping into fifth stump at 150kph, as he swatted to mid-off
good length ball straightening on off. Nudged to mid-on for a quick single
effortless yet crushing! That just flew off the bat, as Kohli pulled off a shortish length around off. What a sound, and the best result. Six over deep midwicket
take that, Woody! Right over the bowler's head, as Wood's fall adds insult to injury. Length ball angling in, as Kohli has made room to loft that with the full face of the bat
fires a yorker on middle right away - and at 149kph - as du Plessis gets across and flicks to long leg
short ball just outside off, and pulled to deep square
good length on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket
much fuller on off, and pushed back to the bowler
flush over mid-on! That follow through spoke of confidence. Short ball heading into off, as he sits deep in the crease to pull and help the ball land right in the RCB dugout
backs away, and Krunal bowls full and wide of off. Dragged to long-off
good length on leg, and clipped to square leg
jumps out of his crease, but Avesh bowls on the shorter side of a length just outside off. Swatted to mid-off from the higher side of the bat
on a good length just outside off, as he opens the bat face to guide the ball, but again finds point
shorter side of a length on top of off, and tapped to point. Du Plessis sends Kohli back

length delivery, and punished! Very nicely timed. Just a little opening of the bat face, and the ball rushes away. Just outside off, as he takes half a stride forward to have a go for four more to deep point's right
much fuller ball, shaping in to hit pad. But that was heading down leg, as Kohli missed his flick
drilled to deep extra cover! A hard punch off a good length ball, angling in a bit to end on fifth stump. Kohli waited, and rammed it away
just wide of mid-on! That came off the inside half of the bat, and was aerial too. Fuller ball and flatter on off, as du Plessis swung across the line
good length on middle and off, and clipped to deep midwicket
length ball around sixth stump, and pushed to point
good length ball on leg, and whipped to deep midwicket
backs away, and swats to long-off, which is placed quite wide. Shorter length, and angling in to end outside leg
good length, angling into the stumps. Punched to long-off
makes room early, and the bowler follows. On a good length, and angling well down the leg side. Takes his pad towards fine leg, as Kohli tries to clip
extra bounce, and Kohli is beaten! It's all happening here. Shorter side of a length just outside off, as Kohli went poking but the ball went past the outside edge
now goes inside out! Length ball around sixth stump, as Kohli reaches out while opening the bat face, and lofts over extra cover for four

top edge... but six! Some early luck for the local hero. Short delivery from Avesh, rising on off stump, as Kohli swivelled while trying to pull. He didn't it quite right, but the ball sailed over the keeper's head
again Kohli walks down but gets a shortish ball shaping into off. Tapped down close to the pitch on the off side
full delivery angling in a bit to end on off. Tapped to the right of point
gets across, and clips this good length ball on middle and off to deep square
back of a length on middle, and dabbed to point with the open face of the bat
ah, Rahul had pushed point in the deep, so Kohli punches this good length ball around off there
walks down again, as this ball is a bit shorter than the previous one, and heading down off side. Pushed to point
skips down... and flings it over point. Unadkat went on a good length, angling it across while finishing it on middle stump
on the fuller side of a length on off, as Kohli is deep in the crease while driving to the cover fielder

Harshal beats Avesh but he sets off for the run. DK fumbles! And they get the single away! LSG win amid high drama! Karthik didn't collect cleanly and Bishnoi was already halfway down after throwing his bat while setting off only. The fumble means Avesh got through to the other end. Avesh throws his helmet as the celebrations begin
Holes out at long-on! Banged in short and Unadkat went for the pull. Picks up Faf du Plessis, who takes it reverse-cupped before switching it to a more normal hold
Banged in short and Bishnoi pulls it to deep square and now LSG need 1 off two deliveries. Scores are level!
Full outside off, Bishnoi digs it out through point and they get two! He found the gap and they ran hard for their lives!
Harshal castles Wood! It's that dipping slower ball and it has done Wood in! Crashes into middle-stump!
Yorker on off but Unadkat gets it out to mid-off
Full on leg, Unadkat swings it away to deep midwicket
Yorker on leg, Wood digs it out to sweeper cover for a single. Unadkat wanted a second but Wood denies the run

Badoni gets a six, but it won't count be cause his bat has crashed into the stumps! Badoni moves across to scoop this behind. Nailed the shot, but his right hand came off the bat and the toe-end just hit the stumps! Oh my! What drama
Hammered wide of long-on! Back of a length on off, Badoni moves across and slaps this hard and past the fielder
On a length on off and going across, he cuts to sweeper cover
Full on off and he drives it out to deep point
Full outside off again, with Badoni moving across again, and it's called a wide again!

Full outside off and going across and it's called wide immediately. RCB have reviewed it! Badoni had moved across to off-stump. But it was still out of reach for the batter, the third umpire says, and the decision will stand
Another full toss outside off, he moves across and clips it to deep midwicket
Full on middle and leg, Unadkat swings it out to deep square
Low full toss wide of off, Badoni goes across and sweep-flicks it to deep midwicket for a single
Very full outside off and Unadkat this time drives it out to sweeper cover
First-ball four for Unadkat! Low, dipping full toss on off and Unadkat just gets bat on it and gets it past Dinesh Karthik!
Low full toss outside off, Badoni whips it away to deep midwicket

Full toss on leg and Pooran picks out deep backward square! This will be checked for height on the full toss, though. And it will be an umpire review as it's a catch. Pooran looked to flick that away behind square, but spooned a catch to Shahbaz Ahmed in the deep. Ball-tracking shows that was fine and Pooran has to go! Siraj has got the key wicket of Pooran, but is this too late for RCB?
On a length on off, Badoni eases it to long-on

Banged in short outside off. This time it's called wide as Badoni misses his pull. RCB have reviewed it for a potential catch now! Nope, that was well high above Badoni's gloves and bat and everything! Absurd review, really
Good bouncer outside off. Badoni misses with his cut and it's another dot for Siraj
On a length outside off, Badoni wants to hammer it away but can only slap it past Siraj to mid-off
Fullish on off, Badoni defends back to Siraj
On a length outside off, Badoni clips it to deep square and they get two
Slogged over deep square! Full on off and Pooran gets down and absolutely hammers this!
On a length on leg, he works it out to deep square
Bangs it in short on middle and leg, Badoni just lets it go past him as it is called a wide

In the air and lands safe! Banged in short outside off and Pooran went for the pull. Got a top edge that lands to his left but three fielders, including the bowler, tried to converge but it fell in no man's land
Full and wide, this time he drives to sweeper cover
And now Badoni joins the party! It's full and wide and he slices it over short third! A few bounces and over the rope
Low full toss outside off, he drives it out to mid-off. Pooran wanted the single but is sent back
Slapped in front of point! Back of length outside off and Pooran cuts it hard and beats the backward point fielder
Swung over long-on for his half-century! Pooran has a half-century off 15 deliveries! The fastest fifty of the season. Full on off and Pooran had no difficulty in muscling that down the ground
Banged in short on leg, Badoni cuts to deep point to bring Pooran back on strike
On a length outside off, he pulls it out to deep midwicket
Full on off and Pooran swings it over square leg for a one-bounce boundary!
Back of a length on middle and leg, Badoni steers it to deep third

What was that from Pooran? That was quick and short on leg and Pooran is quick to react, swivelling and almost playing a check-shot on the pull! Some incredible shots played today and you can add this one to the list
Edged for four. Full and wide and Pooran flashes his bat at it and gets an edge that goes wide of Dinesh Karthik and too fine of short third. Races away
On a length on off, he steers it to short third for a quick single
Full loopy delivery outside off, Badoni drives to cover. Pooran was off for the run but is sent back
Full on off, he looks to work it fine of short third but the fielder does well to cut that out
And he goes for six more! Dragged down outside leg and Pooran swipes it over fine leg, just helping it along it's way
On a length on leg, he goes back and nudges it out to deep backward square
Slapped over extra cover now! Full and wide this time from Karn and Pooran reaches out and gets a good connection there
Slogs it away! Tossed up full on off and Pooran gets down on one knee and smacks it away behind square leg
Tosses it up full on off, he presses forward and defends towards cover and sneaks a quick single
Quick and flat on middle, Badoni is quick to go back and whip it away between deep square and midwicket
Dropped short on leg, Badoni works it away fine down leg and Harshal does well to stop it from racing away to the rope
Full on off and going across, Pooran flashes a drive and scythes it behind point to pick up a boundary
Goes for the wide yorker and nails it. Pooran reaches out but it squeezes under the bat and through to Dinesh Karthik
Bangs it in short on off, Pooran lets it go as it's called wide for height
Back of a length on off, Pooran defends
Full on leg, he clips it out to deep midwicket
Hacked over mid-off. On a length on off, Badoni clears his front leg and hits it just over the fielder and the ball races away. Didn't connect cleanly, but got enough on it
Banged in short on off and going across him, Badoni looked to pull but it goes down leg. Karthik thought there was an edge but RCB don't venture a review here

And Siraj strikes immediately! KL Rahul picks out deep square! Full on leg and he looked to flick it away. Doesn't get the connection he wanted and it's straight to Kohli, who is thrilled after taking the catch. Rahul falls for 18 off 20 and I am sure he will come in for some slack after this knock!
Pooran, welcome to the party! Tossed up outside off and he slogs this over cow corner! That was high and it travelled far!
Quicker and flatter on a length on off, Pooran defends

Karn Sharma has his revenge! Brave of him to toss it up outside off again. Stoinis goes for the drive again but ends up slicing it up to deep point where Shahbaz makes no mistake despite a slight wobble! He is thrilled. Stoinis walks back having played a blinder here!
On a length on off, it was a legbreak, and he gets an edge to short third
Oh this is pure carnage from Stoinis! Tossed up outside off and he hammers it over extra cover
Tosses it up on a length outside off. It spins away sharply and is rightly called a wide. Stoinis was at full stretch but couldn't reach it
On a length on middle and leg, Rahul backs away and punches it out to long-on to hand the strike back to the danger man, Stoinis
Dispatched over cow corner! Full on middle and Stoinis clears his front leg and clears the rope with ease
Almost a chance for RCB! On a length on off and Stoinis inside-edges it onto his boot and just past leg-stump
Quicker and flatter on middle and off, Stoinis works it to deep midwicket
Crrrreaaaammmed over long-off! Tossed up full and Stoinis makes room and hammers a drive well into the stands. Brings up his fifty too!
Fires it in full down leg, Stoinis wants to clip it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads
Tosses it up full outside off, Rahul drives to deep point

On a length outside off and Stoinis cuts it to the deep point boundary. Shahbaz Ahmed slides to stop it. Was his foot touching the rope as he pushed the ball out? Yes it was. He tried hard but couldn't keep LSG from getting four
On a length outside off, Stoinis was backing away but had to move closer and cuts it to backward point

Quick and flat on a length on middle, Rahul squeezes it out to the bowler's right and takes another quick single. Karn misses his throw at the non-striker's end. A direct hit would have been a wicket there
On a length on off, Stoinis backs away and cuts to deep point
And now he gets four down the ground! Pitched up on middle and Stoinis again makes room and slaps it back over the bowler's head
Stoinis welcomes RCB's impact sub with a huge maximum over midwicket! Karn Sharma drags it down on middle and leg and Stoinis quickly makes room and whacks it away
Full on off, punched out to cover for another quick single
On a length on off, Stoinis stands tall and punches it out to deep point. Good running as they pick up two there
Good comeback by Harshal. On a length outside off, angling in and then just straightening to go past the outside edge as Stoinis looks to drive
And another four! Full on off and Stoinis drills it hard past him and beats long-off.
Flashed away over short third now. Full and wide and Stoinis slashed at it. Got a thick edge that flew over the fielder
Glorious! That's full around off and Stoinis clips it off his pads and that goes 75 metres
Bangs it in short on leg, Stoinis waits for the slower ball and pulls it to deep square
On a length on middle and leg and he works it out to deep midwicket again
Full on leg, he clips it away to deep midwicket
On a length on off, Stoinis cuts it away to point
Back of a length on leg, Rahul clips it out to deep midwicket for a single
Gets it past fine leg! Parnell bangs it in short outside leg, Stoinis swivels and pulls and just beats the fielder at short fine for a much needed boundary to end the powerplay
On a length on middle and leg and ending up on off. Stoinis punches it out to mid-off
Back of a length on leg, Stoinis parries to midwicket
On a length on off, Rahul cuts to point for another single
Full on off and going across him, Stoinis stays tall and drives to point
Full on off, Rahul drives to point
Beautiful timing! Full on off and he just pushes at it gently and gets it between cover and mid-off
High in the air, and dropped by Siraj! Full on middle and leg and Stoinis wanted to flick it away. Got a thick top edge and skied it. Siraj was running back and had to dive and can't hold on
On a length on off, Stoinis blocks
Full on middle, swinging into Stoinis, who defends it
Lovely ball. Back of a length on off and going across him, he has a push at it but the ball goes past the outside edge
Full on leg, he clips it to mid-on and gets a quick single
And the swing brings another wicket for Parnell! Pitches it up outside off again and this time Krunal gets the edge and DK makes no mistake! What a first over for Parnell!
And that swing is on display here! Parnell pitches it up outside off and it swings away from Krunal who had a whaft at it

Has he edged that? Dinesh Karthik thinks so and RCB review immediately. Full on middle and going across him, Hooda had a little push at it. He is walking even before the review is completed. And UltraEdge confirms that there was bat on that! Dinesh Karthik took a good low catch to his right and he knew straight away. Parnell has his first of the season!
On a length down leg and it swings away late. Called wide, of course
Flicked away effortlessly! Full on leg and he just clips it off his pads over midwicket and it bounces a couple of times before reaching the rope
On a length on leg, he clips it through midwicket. David Willey runs back to recover
On a length on middle, Rahul eases it towards cover for a comfortable single
Brute of a short ball outside off. Rahul wants to cut but it flies over his bat. That was at 148kmph
Full outside off and angling into off, Rahul defends back to the bowler
Full on off, he punches it back past the bowler to mid-off
Back of length delivery around off, Hooda hangs back and clips it wide of mid-on
Full outside off, he gets a thick outside edge and it runs to deep third

Full on middle and leg, he clips it away through midwicket. Harshal Patel does well to run in from deep square and dive to stop that. Had his leg touched the rope when he was pushing the ball out? Replays show yes!
On a length on middle and off, he punches it out to backward point but they decide against the single
Just clears the fielder! Full on middle, he makes room and scythes it over extra cover. Faf du Plessis runs back from mid-off but the ball lands beyond him
On a length on off, Rahul punches it down the ground past the bowler and du Plessis does well to cut it out from mid-off
Pitches it up outside off, Hooda drives it wide of mid-off for another quick single
A quick single to midwicket. This was on a length on leg and he clips it to the fielder and takes off immediately. A direct hit would have seen Rahul on his way back but the fielder misses his throw
On a length on off, hint of shape into the right-hander, and Rahul defends towards point
On a length on off and angling in, Hooda goes across to flick it away but misses. Doesn't matter for LSG, though, as it goes off his thigh to the fine leg boundary
Pitches it up fuller this time, outside off and Hooda drives to point
On a length on off, Hooda gets in line to block

Castled! It's the sweet sound of timber and Siraj is pumped! Bangs it in back of a length on middle, goes across this time but cramps him for room and Mayers chops on. He is the form player and that's a good early wicket for RCB
Raps him on the pad as Siraj gets a length ball around leg to jag back in. He appeals but the umpire isn't interested. Could have pitched outside leg and pssibly sliding down as well
Goes full and wide, Mayers has a swing and misses. This was too wide, the umpire reckons
Back of a length on middle, jagging back into him and Mayers cops one in the box! Ouch!
